analysis.primary: Per-case paired generic excess above exact base, triggered likeness, detection coverage and strength curves. Keep known diagnostics and fresh wording separate.
analysis.fizgig: Pinned upstream windows, conditions, image-distance summaries, verdicts and repair_settings(down=0.5) run unchanged. Block masks and recommended weights rendered through the shared ComfyUI backend, not the Fizgig UI. Uses all34 common references with the upstream mean-pairwise profile score; final evaluation uses the common normalized-centroid score. No manual tuning on evaluation images.
analysis.selection: Only the separate studio calibration pair and seeds select Fizgig settings. A/B mu and ridge, all strength grids and evaluation prompts fixed before results. B has additional strengths2.5/5 because its rank-space fit can attenuate the whole response; source0.25/0.5 controls simple attenuation.
analysis.fairness: Same source LoRA and deployment model for repairs; A/B share historical captures. Fizgig uses its rendered profile calibration instead of those captures. This compares practical repair procedures, not equal-data/equal-compute training or all Fizgig capabilities.
analysis.limitations: One character, two render seeds per case. Known cases previously inspected; fresh wordings are not broad cross-subject generalization. No evaluation-based retuning, missing-face scores are null, apparent superiority requires comparable likeness/leakage tradeoffs.
